Fixes shared folders in the vanilla Arch guest. The Windows folder selected in Settings now mounts automatically at `/mnt/host` and appears as `~/<Windows folder name>`, including names with spaces. Existing files at that home-folder name are preserved.

Download **TryArch.exe** for new installations. Existing Arch installations keep their account, packages, and files; updating the launcher does not replace their Linux disk or install new guest services.

To add the fix to an existing installation, download **tryarch-shared-folder-fix.tar.gz** and **SHA256SUMS** into Arch, verify the archive, then run:

```sh
sha256sum --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS
tar -xzf tryarch-shared-folder-fix.tar.gz
sudo install -m755 usr/local/bin/try-arch-share /usr/local/bin/try-arch-share
sudo install -m644 etc/systemd/system/try-arch-share.service /etc/systemd/system/try-arch-share.service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now try-arch-share
```

Select a shared folder in Settings and restart Arch if it was not already attached. Files edited or deleted in the share are changed on Windows too.

The repair was checked with the Windows QEMU runtime for normal-user read/write access and automatic mounting during a normal boot. The release pipeline also boots the rebuilt guest and checks sharing before producing the launcher.

Windows 10/11 on Intel/AMD x86_64 with Windows Hypervisor Platform is required. The launcher is unsigned and automatic updates remain disabled. Kernel package upgrades still require matching external kernel/initramfs assets.
